name: @parity/ppn
description: Spin up a local Polkadot ecosystem: fetch, generate, fork and run a network

scripts.prepack: pnpm --dir ../dashboard-ui build && rm -rf scripts config zombienet-configs networks && cp -R ../../scripts ../../config ../../zombienet-configs ../../networks . && rm -rf scripts/node_modules && find scripts config zombienet-configs -name "*.test.*" -delete && rm -f config/ports.local.env scripts/run-tests.sh scripts/validate-ports.sh && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
scripts.postpack: rm -rf scripts config zombienet-configs networks && rm -f LICENSE
